Tells how much of a channel [ChannelSend](ChannelSend) sends to a bus. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Print GetChannelSend(ch, hall)
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound), [PlayMusic](PlayMusic), [EmitSound](EmitSound) or [MovieChannel](MovieChannel).
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@returns The level, `0` when the channel sends nothing there or is over.
